sections.title: Table notes
lines: The adventure shows the juvenile swimming in Tideswell Cave. The card prints one speed of 30 ft. without a separate swim speed.
In the Wakewyrm’s Pool encounter, a DC 16 Wisdom (Animal Handling) check calms the juvenile. It lashes out at creatures in bite range if they fail to calm it. See adventure booklet p. 8.

lines: An immense sea reptile with a long eel-like body and a spined ridge.

sections.title: Attacks
lines: Bite · Melee Weapon Attack · +8 to hit · reach 20 ft. · 3d6 + 5 piercing
Tail · Melee Weapon Attack · +8 to hit · reach 25 ft. · 3d8 + 5 bludgeoning

sections.title: Traits mechanics
lines: Hold Breath · Can hold its breath for 1 hour.

sections.title: Actions mechanics
lines: Multiattack · 2 attacks · One Bite and one Tail attack, or two Bites.

Bite · +8 to hit · reach 20 ft. · One target takes 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage on a hit and is grappled on a failed save (escape DC 16). The wakewyrm can grapple only one creature. While holding that creature it cannot bite another. · DC 16 Strength · 3d6 + 5 piercing
Tail · +8 to hit · reach 25 ft. · One target takes 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage on a hit. · 3d8 + 5 bludgeoning

Swallow · The wakewyrm bites a Large or smaller creature it is grappling. On a hit the creature is swallowed and the grapple ends. The swallowed creature is blinded, restrained, and has total cover from outside effects. It takes 11 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each wakewyrm turn. If the wakewyrm takes at least 18 damage from a creature inside, it saves at the end of that turn or expels all swallowed creatures prone within 10 ft. When it dies, swallowed creatures are freed from restraint and can escape by spending 20 ft. of movement. · DC 15 Constitution · 3d6 acid

sections.title: Table notes
lines: The adult lingers near the coast while searching for its offspring. After death its body floats for several hours before sinking.
Hit Point Press, The Wakewyrm's Fury, Reference Cards, p. 5.

target.name: Grappled
target.description: Your speed becomes 0. The grapple ends if you are moved out of the grappler’s reach.

target.name: Blinded
target.description: You cannot see. Your attacks have disadvantage, and attacks against you have advantage.

target.name: Restrained
target.description: Your speed is 0. Your attacks and Dexterity saves have disadvantage, and attacks against you have advantage.

target.name: Prone
target.description: You can crawl or stand up. Your attacks have disadvantage, and nearby attackers have advantage against you.
